assumptions.label: How this estimate works
assumptions.text: Words written are the same unit as the goal, so the saved conversion is one to one, allowing for words that get cut in editing.

assumptions.label: Starting from your last report
assumptions.text: The scenario starts today. Last reported words written: 2330 (2026-09-04). Changes since that report are unknown; update it to revise this estimate.

assumptions.label: Future work
assumptions.text: Until two complete weeks are measured, the saved input budget is a scenario, with half to one-and-a-half times that pace. This is a provisional sensitivity range.

assumptions.label: Gaps in the record
assumptions.text: Missing expected records and unanswered quantities are unknown and exclude a week or matched period. Days without planned work are labelled separately, not recorded as failed or zero-activity days.

assumptions.label: How work relates to the result
assumptions.text: The saved input-to-outcome conversion continues to apply.

assumptions.label: Feedback delay
assumptions.text: No additional delay between input and outcome is assumed.

assumptions.label: What the range means
assumptions.text: The shaded fan is a conditional scenario range, not a confidence interval or a guarantee. Future cycles are not bookings.
